name: Castelldans (Spain)
description: Light blue field with the middle vertical third yellow and a white pale at the centre of each outer third.
history: The official flag of Castelldans is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with the second vertical third yellow and a white pale of width 1/18 of the length of the cloth at the centre of the first and third thirds; approved on 16 November 2001 and published in the DOGC on 5 December 2001; it is based on the arms of the town.

features.role: narrow pale at the centre of the hoist third
narrow pale at the centre of the fly third
